children: ) (“AGI”, the “Company”, “we” or “our”) will hold a conference call on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 8:00am ET to discuss its results for the three-months ending September 30, 2026. A news release announcing AGI’s results will be issued after markets close on Wednesday, November 11, 2026.

To attend the event, please join using the AGI Third Quarter Results webcast link. Alternatively, participants can dial-in using +1-833-821-0159 if calling from Canada or the U.S. and +1-647-846-2271 internationally.

A replay of the webcast will be made available on AGI’s website. In addition, an audio replay of the call will be available for seven days. To access the audio replay, please dial +1-855-669-9658 if calling from Canada or the U.S. and +1-412-317-0088 internationally. Please enter access code 1380637# for the audio replay.

AGI is a provider of the equipment and solutions required to support the efficient storage, transport, and processing of food globally. AGI has manufacturing facilities in Canada, the United States, Brazil, India, France, and Italy and distributes its product worldwide.
